steps.title: two notes tell you the quality
steps.body:
After the root, the quality. Two notes decide most of it: the 3rd and the 7th.

- `maj7`: major 3rd, major 7th. Bright, settled.
- `7`: major 3rd, flat 7th. Wants to move.
- `m7`: minor 3rd, flat 7th. Soft, at home.
- `m7b5`: minor 3rd, flat 5th, flat 7th. The darkest of the five.
- `sus`: no 3rd at all. It floats.

Tap the family of each chord while it plays. This loop has four chords and four different qualities.
